text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"We have that math quiz tomorrow, huh... 
Haaah, guess I gotta study."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Gaaah! I don't get it at all!! How am I 
supposed to solve this?!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"...No, no! Get fired up, me! I can't pull 
off something as uncool as throwing in the 
towel!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Alright! If that's how it is, I'll review 
every single textbook from cover to cover!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Katsuragi Ace ended up staying up late 
because she was studying so hard.
